targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (meter_id)
    meter_id, power_kw, power_factor
  FROM realtime_electricity
  WHERE meter_id IN (
    'E-WH','E-EXH1','E-EXH2','E-ELV2','E-ELV3','E-QAHB','E-FIRE','E-WASTE',
    'E-CRANE','E-DYE3','E-DYE1','E-DYE2','E-FIBAC','E-PRO1','E-FIB1','E-BOIL',
    'E-PRINT','E-OFF','E-RSV1','E-RSV2','E-RSV3','E-SEC',
    'E-ATS1','E-ATS2','E-AIR','E-SOC2'
  )
  ORDER BY meter_id, time DESC
)
SELECT
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-WH')    AS "WH_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-WH')    AS "WH_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-EXH1')  AS "EXH1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-EXH1')  AS "EXH1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-EXH2')  AS "EXH2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-EXH2')  AS "EXH2_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ELV2')  AS "ELV2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ELV2')  AS "ELV2_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ELV3')  AS "ELV3_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ELV3')  AS "ELV3_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-QAHB')  AS "QAHB_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-QAHB')  AS "QAHB_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIRE')  AS "FIRE_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIRE')  AS "FIRE_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-WASTE') AS "WASTE_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-WASTE') AS "WASTE_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-CRANE') AS "CRANE_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-CRANE') AS "CRANE_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE3')  AS "DYE3_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE3')  AS "DYE3_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE1')  AS "DYE1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE1')  AS "DYE1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE2')  AS "DYE2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-DYE2')  AS "DYE2_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIBAC') AS "FIBAC_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIBAC') AS "FIBAC_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-PRO1')  AS "PRO1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-PRO1')  AS "PRO1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIB1')  AS "FIB1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-FIB1')  AS "FIB1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-BOIL')  AS "BOIL_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-BOIL')  AS "BOIL_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-PRINT') AS "PRINT_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-PRINT') AS "PRINT_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-OFF')   AS "OFF_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-OFF')   AS "OFF_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV1')  AS "RSV1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV1')  AS "RSV1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV2')  AS "RSV2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV2')  AS "RSV2_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV3')  AS "RSV3_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-RSV3')  AS "RSV3_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-SEC')   AS "SEC_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-SEC')   AS "SEC_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ATS1')  AS "ATS1_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ATS1')  AS "ATS1_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ATS2')  AS "ATS2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-ATS2')  AS "ATS2_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-AIR')   AS "AIR_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-AIR')   AS "AIR_PF",
  MAX(power_kw)     FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-SOC2')  AS "SOC2_kW",
  MAX(power_factor) FILTER (WHERE meter_id = 'E-SOC2')  AS "SOC2_PF"
FROM latest;
